tagline: Your mouse, your keys, every time it reconnects
brief: A menu-bar app for macOS that replaces BetterMouse and Karabiner for one person's setup: MX Master buttons over HID++, a hyper key on Caps Lock, smooth scrolling with a tuned curve, and every setting re-applied the moment a device reconnects. It should feel precise, quiet and native.
criteria: Success: reads as the Caps Lock key and a pointer at once, survives as an 18 pt menu-bar template icon, works in one colour.

concepts.name: Caps pointer
concepts.idea: The Caps Lock glyph tipped over 22 degrees until it becomes a pointer.
rationale: Caps Lock is the key Hyperpoint turns into hyper; the pointer is what it drives
Outlined like the real ⇪ legend, so it reads as a key glyph
The bar is the accent: the key's lit LED
Tilt makes it lively but costs clarity below 24 px

recommendation: Caps pointer as the symbol, app icon and menu-bar icon, with the Inter Display wordmark.
next_steps: Drop AppIcon.icns and the menu-bar template into the app
Check the menu-bar icon on a real display at 18 pt
Optional: custom-draw one letter of the wordmark for ownership
